title: Classification of TLR-Compatible Tweakable Permutations
summary: The paper defines TLR-compatible families and gives Luby-Rackoff-based examples, while a complete classification of such tweakable-permutation families remains open.

scope.domain: Classification of tweakable-permutation families used in Luby-Rackoff-based cryptographic constructions.
parameters: tweak-space form: the paper gives examples for empty, fixed-length, and variable-length tweak spaces
scope.unresolved_remainder: A complete classification of all TLR-compatible tweakable-permutation families.

progress.summary: The source defines TLR-compatible families and gives Luby-Rackoff-based examples for empty, fixed-length, and variable-length tweak spaces. It presents classification of all such families as a research direction outside the paper's scope.
citation_labels: Bishwajit Chakraborty et al., Tweakable Permutation-based Luby-Rackoff Constructions
